s.note: the North Pole security command centre
s.how: Bake 6 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour, halve and scoop out most of the flesh. Fill with 150g grated cheese and 3 chopped bacon rashers and bake 10 minutes. Serve with sour cream.

s.note: the elves at the North Pole
s.how: Tip 200g mixed nuts, 200g chocolate buttons and 150g dried cranberries into a big bowl and toss. Serve before the opening credits so everyone can grab a handful.

m.note: Santa keeping fit for the big night
m.how: Roast 800g sweet potato wedges at 220C for 35 minutes. Grill 4 rump steaks for 3 minutes a side, rest for 5 minutes and serve with the sweet potato and 300g steamed green beans.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g flour and chill. Roll, cut and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Ice in red and green.

d.note: a cold night at the North Pole
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming and whisk in 150g chopped milk chocolate until smooth. Pour into 4 mugs and top with whipped cream. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
